integrity: All displayed formulas were reconstructed from the stated Gaussian model. The uniqueness proof uses strict log-concavity of the Gaussian CDF via the inverse Mills ratio. Numerical values are independently recomputed by the bundled standard-library verifier. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Known-variance scalar Gaussian model; one-sided sign screening and independent z confirmation; optimizes joint selection-and-rejection probability at fixed positive signal. The weak-signal limit is a local design benchmark. Cox (1975) studies allocation in a different many-normal-means data-splitting problem; only its abstract was accessible, so older equivalent-formula risk remains.
title: A sharp information-allocation law for Gaussian fission screening and confirmation
